My name is Justin Mascarenhas and I graduated with an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I am reaching out about the Autonomy Engineer, Deep Learning role at Skydio because your work as a robotics engineer sits close to the kind of perception and autonomy problems I have been building toward.

My background is in computer vision and deep learning for robotics, including training and deploying detection and segmentation models, working with monocular depth estimation, and optimizing inference so it runs fast enough for real hardware. I built a vision guided robotic arm that runs perception and control together on embedded hardware, and I have also worked on an autonomous driving stack in simulation that handled perception and planning end to end.

If the team is hiring for something like this, I would really appreciate it if you would be open to referring me or pointing me toward the right person.
